AX-001 v2 defense-like assessment FAILS (CRISIS regime SR -0.160 vs S1 +0.018 — hedge underperforms in worst regime). Hard gate FAILs (RF-J1 turnover 746% > 600% / Hurdle Hard post-cost MDD -46.26% > -45% / Gate_FactorRegression_R²_strict 0.299 < 0.30 with silent 0.005 tolerance override exposed / AX-008 INSUFFICIENT 1/2 minimum / Harvey NOT_VERIFIED) prevent any future promotion path without successor remediation. Per spec request.json decision_rule.MONITORING_ONLY clause ('factor regression quality OK + trading damage 큼') the advisory verdict is MONITORING_ONLY; both spec verdict + hard gate audit recorded honestly per Charter v1.7 §8 No Silent Override. rationale.ax_001_v2_summary: Defense-like 3-tuple per request.json axiom_constraints.AX-001_v2 + judge ax_001_v2_defense_like_evaluation. (a) crisis_alpha: M4+FH CRISIS SR -0.160 < S1 baseline +0.018 — DETERIORATES in worst regime; CAGR drag -4.16pp; MDD relief crisis 4.82pp marginal. (b) Core MDD pp post-cost: only -1.75pp vs M4 (target -3pp per spec) — pre-cost -6.67pp BUT trading damage erases relief. (c) bad/normal SR ratio: NORMAL 1.044 / CAUTION 1.155 / CRISIS -0.160 — ratio_crisis_normal = -0.153 (NEGATIVE, hedge does NOT provide tail protection in deepest stress). Per AX-001 v2 conditional metric: bad/normal CRISIS DETERIORATES (negative ratio) → NOT SATISFIED for deployment. CAUTION regime is the only regime where hedge adds value (+0.22 SR vs S1) but CRISIS deterioration dominates. Method substitution disclosure: L-274 reference uses M4 BOCPD; current run uses iter31 static cash overlay (BULL=0/NORMAL=10/CAUTION=20/CRISIS=40); estimated split SR -0.30 hedge redistribution + SR -0.20 BOCPD vs static substitution = -0.50 total SR delta vs L-274 frozen. Verdict directionally consistent with governor MONITORING_ONLY (not deployment-grade defense intervention).

rationale.factor_beta_hedge_marginal_value_diagnos: Forge canonical M4+FactorBeta_Hedge SR 1.2459 < L-274 frozen reference SR 1.7477 (delta -0.5018 SR). Decomposition: (i) factor-beta hedge weight redistribution ≈ -0.30 SR + (ii) BOCPD vs static iter31 cash schema substitution ≈ -0.20 SR. Both attribution components are approximate (not measurement-isolating ablation per spec scope-bound 3-variant comparison). Empirically: β_F1 reduction 55.17% real but post-cost net IR negative across both hedge variants (FH -0.163 / M4+FH -0.366). Mechanism: QP weight perturbation away from alpha-anchor degrades alpha capture more than it reduces tail (judge Gate_C_Net_Alpha_vs_Cost FAIL). +62pp annual TO (S1 716.6% → FH 778.7%) costs ~1.7pp CAGR with only -1.75pp MDD improvement post-cost. AX-007 mechanism break: single_sleeve_long_only_top20 hedge constraint cannot achieve simultaneous alpha preservation + factor exposure neutralization + low TO at K=5 PCA structure. Conclusion: Factor-beta hedge has NEGATIVE marginal value over already-deployed STR_1715 M4 schedule for single-sleeve context. Retained as research artifact for potential multi-sleeve / long-short / 50+ stocks contexts (AX-007 exception 4 paths).

The 1.5855 / 1.5646 / 1.2459 dispersion across WTs reflects measurement basis differences (LRO uses overlay-residualized basis; RMT uses Σ-cleaning basis with rule-max binding; FactorBeta uses QP-redistribution basis). M4 BOCPD vs static iter31 cash schema substitution alone explains ≈ -0.20 SR; remainder ≈ -0.30 SR is factor-beta hedge weight redistribution effect. Honest gap path recommendation per Charter v1.7 §9: Defense / Crisis Alpha family pivot (Iter 9 — Growth × Investor_Flow / Skewness × CFO accrual / Macro × Profitability conditional per L-270) is more direct MDD -7.05pp gap closure than statistical factor-beta hedge approach in single-sleeve context.
